title: WPMS/3174/2018 of THDC INDIA LTD. DEHRADUN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 3174 of 2018 (M/S)
THDC India Limited .....Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others ....Respondents
Present :
Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Anurag Bisaria, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for private respondents.

Dated: 20th March, 2019
JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.

In this Writ Petition, the petitioner has given challenge to
the impugned orders dated 22nd February, 2018 and 24th March, 2018,
as passed by respondent No. 3.
2. When the Writ Petition was entertained, notices were
issued to the private respondents. The petitioner has taken steps on
30th October, 2018 and the Registry has given its report on 20th
December, 2018 that neither AD nor un-delivered envelope has been
received back by the Registry. However, later on the petitioner was
directed to take fresh steps by the by Court's order dated 3rd January,
2019. In pursuance to the steps taken by the petitioner on 10th
January, 2019, Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, learned counsel for private
respondents, has put in appearance on behalf of respondent Nos. 5 to
8.
3. The Controversy at hand, as against the impugned orders
dated 22nd February, 2018 and 24th March, 2018, as passed by
respondent No. 3, already stood adjudicated by this Court in a Bunch
of Writ Petitions, with a leading Writ Petition, being Writ Petition
No. 2924 of 2018 (MS/), THDC India Limited Vs. State of

2
Uttarakhand and others, which has been decided by this Court on
12th March, 2019. Thus, this Writ Petition too would stand allowed in
terms of the judgment dated 12th March, 2019, rendered in Writ
Petition No. 2924 of 2018 (MS/), THDC India Limited Vs. State of
Uttarakhand and others and this judgment would constitute to be
part of today's order passed in this Writ Petition.
4. However, there would be no order as to costs
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 20.03.2019
Shiv
